literal: Commentary says: Lu Xuan's inherited work was renowned; he was first to answer the imperial summons, and descendants followed in his tracks as a great house of the age.
idiomatic: Commentary: Lu Xuan's inherited fame led the summons; descendants followed as a great house.

literal: Their civil and military achievements are scarcely worth recording, yet they were valued in their time and their fame topped the gentry—surely their virtue, work, and Confucian plainness surpassed others.
idiomatic: Their civil and military deeds scarcely merit record, yet they were valued and famed among gentry—virtue and Confucian plainness surpassed others.

literal: Boyuan's brothers also had the elegance of two regions; their refined family voice—the sons did not match.
idiomatic: Boyuan's brothers had two-region elegance and refined family voice—the sons did not match.

literal: Sidao was a peerless talent of an age, yet his official path was sparse; though one says fortune has its mandate, perhaps it was also from not guarding small conduct.
idiomatic: Sidao was an age's peerless talent yet sparse in office; though fortune has mandate, perhaps not guarding small conduct.

literal: Qian and Changheng were models of refined plainness; family style was well continued and the hall frame unimpaired.
idiomatic: Qian and Changheng modeled refined plainness; family style continued and the frame unimpaired.

literal: Zigang's wine-besotted eccentricity was still of the bright-pearl kind.
idiomatic: Zigang's wine eccentricity was still bright-pearl kind.

literal: Changren's remonstrance was weighty—one basket-tip and it toppled; pity!
idiomatic: Changren's remonstrance was weighty—one basket-tip and toppled; pity!

literal: Boju and Zhongxuan were both strong in refinement.
idiomatic: Boju and Zhongxuan were both strong in refinement.

literal: Shubiao's aims were broad and far; he delighted in chivalry and loved stratagem.
idiomatic: Shubiao aimed broad and far, delighted in chivalry and stratagem.

literal: Wenwei's standing was weighty and his land splendid; he had early resolve; through straits of hardship he at last met a heroic lord—though rank was not grand, he was still one who aided the mandate.
idiomatic: Wenwei's standing was weighty with early resolve; through hardship he met a heroic lord—rank not grand, yet one who aided the mandate.

literal: Xunzu's words were brilliant and he gained fame early; trusting his talent and station, he indulged pride—office never heard of him, and he died young.
idiomatic: Xunzu's words were brilliant and fame early; trusting talent he indulged pride—no office heard, young death.

literal: Had he lived to full years, whether blocked or open could not be measured.
idiomatic: Had he lived full years, blocked or open could not be measured.

literal: Shulun's substance was vast and thick, bending and extending together.
idiomatic: Shulun's substance was vast, bending and extending together.

literal: Zizhang's cruelty was his aim—the kind that brings blame.
idiomatic: Zizhang aimed at cruelty—the blameworthy kind.

literal: Jingyu's brothers had elegant work worth honoring; though they chose different trees in different states, they both made strong names.
idiomatic: Jingyu's brothers had elegant work worth honor; though in different states, both made strong names.

literal: Bian's additions and reductions completed the task—perhaps he was superior.
idiomatic: Bian's additions completed the task—perhaps superior.

literal: Yong, though civil and martial differed in bent, each had its beauty.
idiomatic: Yong, civil and martial differing, each had beauty.

literal: Ben's fickleness, though pleasing those who repaid him, when shifted to himself—how could he still revile others?
idiomatic: Ben's fickleness pleased those who repaid him, yet shifted to himself—how revile others?

literal: Driven off at the end of the road—what wonder?
idiomatic: Driven off at the end—what wonder?

literal: Dan did not ruin Confucian work—that too is praise enough.
idiomatic: Dan did not ruin Confucian work—that is praise enough.
